design_intent: Represent the older LineAlert deterministic diagnostic/historian capability as a first-class evidence input to the operator-friendly bounded-action loop.

prior_similar_machine_episodes.pattern: presentation variability rose before visible alignment complaint
prior_similar_machine_episodes.outcome: guide/presentation setup restored; subsequent bounded evidence returned toward healthy window

prior_similar_machine_episodes.pattern: presentation variability elevated at unchanged production speed
prior_similar_machine_episodes.outcome: guide/presentation relationship localized and corrected; verification improved

prior_similar_machine_episodes.pattern: camera skew coincided with elevated presentation variability
prior_similar_machine_episodes.outcome: presentation-focused correction followed by recovery association

ranking_effect.reason: Current presentation variability resembles prior machine episodes while label-feed timing remains inside the supplied historical healthy band.

post_change_five_bottle_window.interpretation: The one-change diagnostic run moves presentation behavior toward matched healthy windows. This supports the bounded change under test conditions and changes the next ranking; it does not prove root cause or production recovery.

boundaries: historical machine pattern != current root cause
healthy historical timing evidence can deprioritize a path without proving that subsystem healthy in every physical sense
intervention followed by improvement != causal proof
five-bottle diagnostic success != safe production change
synthetic historian evidence != physical machine evidence
